parts.description: Single-piece spoon with a concave bowl, narrow neck, tapered handle, and hanging hole at the handle end.
parts.reasoning: The reference image clearly shows a reflective brushed/polished stainless-steel spoon stamped as one continuous utensil. The 0.196 m length and 0.052 m bowl width match a medium table spoon; using thin sheet-metal construction rather than full bounding-box volume gives a realistic mass of about 52 g. Smooth steel has moderate friction and relatively high hardness, but the thin curved form reduces effective bounce compared with a solid steel block.

object_description: A one-piece polished stainless-steel spoon for utensil simulation. It is modeled as a single rigid body with no articulating parts.
overall_assessment: Stable first-pass rigid-body setup: one polished steel rigid body with realistic utensil-scale mass, friction, and restitution, requiring no articulation tree beyond the root body.
